## Problem

What family, caregiver, content author, or maintainer problem should this solve?

## Proposal

Describe the smallest useful behavior. Please include child-safety, offline, privacy, and accessibility considerations.

## Alternatives

What workarounds or alternatives have you considered?

## Additional context

Do not include private household data, tokens, or unlicensed media.
